description: Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica - Rede Hospital Casa - CLT Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. Retirar aparelhos de imobilização ortopédica, conforme prescrição médica; Utilizar de forma adequada equipamentos como serra elétrica vibratória; Realizar procedimentos específicos em imobilizações ortopédicas, como a abertura de janelas no aparelho gessado; Manter sala de imobilização organizada; Zelar pela limpeza da sala, bem como organização e preservação e guarda de materiais e equipamentos de uso na sua especialidade; Auxiliar o médico ortopedista em procedimentos ortopédicos não cirúrgicos, como na instalação de trações esqueléticas e manobras de redução manual; Realizar lançamento e registro em prontuário dos procedimentos realizados e materiais utilizados; Promover orientações pertinentes e de conservação da imobilização aos pacientes; Auxiliar a equipe multidisciplinar em imobilizações de pacientes vítimas de trauma ou que necessitem de restrição total de movimento; Obedecer às normas técnicas da Sociedade Brasileira de Ortopedia e Traumatologia (SBOT), às normas internacionais para confecção de imobilização, normas regulamentadoras de Segurança do Trabalho e o Código de Ética Profissional; Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda e qualquer ocorrência administrativa; Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda ocorrência durante atendimento ao paciente; Participar de treinamentos institucional e setorial quando solicitado sua participação; Cumprir as normas e regulamentos da Instituição, bem como as rotinas operacionais da sua Unidade; Respeitar e conhecer os instrumentos normativos do setor como instruções de trabalho. Esperamos que você tenha: Ensino médio completo com curso técnico em imobilização ortopédica. Registro no conselho de Classe. Desejável experiência anterior de 06 meses. Noções básicas de Primeiros Socorros a pacientes vítimas de trauma, Higiene ocupacional, biossegurança e ergonomia, equipamentos e Materiais ortopédicos. Noções de Ortopedia e Traumatologia. title: Principal Product Manager, HTS API Marketplace
description: About the Role We are seeking an exceptional Principal Product Manager to build the HTS API Marketplace — the commercial and developer-facing layer through which enterprise partners access Hopper's lodging and cars capabilities. This is a true 0-to-1 role. You will be the person who defines what it is: how capabilities are packaged and priced, how partners discover and integrate them, and how the marketplace evolves as a platform business. The underlying technical capabilities — connectivity orchestration, pricing and sort, content mapping, the extranet — are owned by dedicated capability teams. Your job is to work closely with those PMs to understand, package, and commercially expose those capabilities as coherent, enterprise-grade API products. We expect this PM to move fast and build scrappily. You should be comfortable using AI tools and vibe coding to prototype workflows, mock APIs, and test partner experiences before handing off to engineering. The best candidate will reach for a prototype before a PRD. You will partner with Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Finance, and Supply — and coordinate tightly with other PMs across the organization — to bring the marketplace from concept to a revenue-generating platform. This is a fully remote role. What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like Define what the HTS API Marketplace is: how capabilities are structured, packaged, and priced across a portfolio spanning HTS Connect, Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing, Extranet, Taxes, and Custom Deals Engine. Coordinate with capability PMs — who own the underlying technical systems — to understand each capability's roadmap, constraints, and customization surface, and translate that into externally-consumable API products. Own the commercial model for the marketplace: platform vs. variable fee decisions, take rate structure per capability, enterprise packaging, and the custom deals framework for large partners with differentiated customer segments. Build the developer and partner experience from scratch: API specifications, partner onboarding flows, documentation standards, sandbox environments, and integration tooling that minimizes time-to-first-value. Use AI tools and rapid prototyping to test ideas quickly — mock API responses, prototype partner portals, simulate pricing and ranking configurations — before committing engineering resources. Establish the go-to-market motion for the marketplace: work with Commercial to identify the right partners for each capability, sequence launches, and define what a successful commercial rollout looks like. Own the marketplace revenue P&L: model and track GBV, take rate, and per-capability unit economics in partnership with Finance. Set the sequencing and prioritization across all capabilities — from in-progress work (HTS Connect, Taxes) through scoping-stage products (Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing) to capabilities not yet started (Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Extranet, Custom Deals Engine). Qualifications 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least one 0-to-1 product you built from concept to commercial launch. Demonstrated experience building developer-facing or B2B marketplace products, including ownership of API product design, developer experience, and commercial packaging for enterprise customers. AI-native working style: you use LLMs and vibe coding as first-line tools for prototyping, not as novelties. You have built working demos, mockups, or proof-of-concepts using AI before handing work to engineering. Strong understanding of marketplace economics: take rates, supply-side incentives, demand-side optimization, and the design of platform vs. variable commercial models. Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple product teams — you can synthesize roadmaps, surface dependencies, and drive cross-team alignment without owning the underlying engineering. Experience working with external enterprise partners: translating commercial needs into product requirements and managing partner expectations through multi-phase rollouts. Strong fluency with SQL and large-scale transactional or operational datasets. Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to write crisp API and product documentation. Bonus Experience in travel commerce (lodging, cars, flights) or adjacent industries such as fintech, ads, or marketplace infrastructure. Background in connectivity, distribution, or supplier technology (GDS, channel managers, OTA APIs). Prior experience in Engineering, Data Science, or a technical role. Familiarity with auction or deduplication mechanics, dynamic pricing systems, or recommendation and ranking models. Perks & Benefits Of Working With Us Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages. Hopper will offer and cover 100% of employee premiums for private Major & Minor Medical insurances. Hopper supplements Social Security coverage for liability benefits with Private insurance to cover you and your loved ones from Day 1. Hopper provides employees with a tax-advantageous and secured savings vehicle and matches up to a percentage of employee contributions. Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!. Unlimited PTO. Flexdesk coworking All Access Pass AND Work-from-home stipend. Carrot Cash travel stipend. Hopper offers a monthly subsidy to pay for teleworking utilities. An entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business. Open communication with management and company leadership. Small, dynamic teams = massive impact. More About Hopper At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips. The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials. While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands. Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more. Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth: Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year. Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions. Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel. Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business. Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more. Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers. Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials. Come take off with us! Compensation Range: $150K - $450K #J-18808-Ljbffr

Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade. Organização e Capacidade de Gestão de Backlog: Capacidade de estruturar rotinas e manter o planejamento de entregas alinhado, garantindo previsibilidade para o time. Autonomia em Dados: Habilidade para coletar, interpretar dados e transformá-los em insights acionáveis. Comunicação Assertiva e Colaboração: Habilidade de conectar Engenharia, Design e Stakeholders, garantindo transparência e alinhamento em todas as etapas. Resiliência em Cenários Ambíguos: Conforto para atuar em ambientes de rápida mudança, transformando incertezas em planos de ação claros. Visão de Negócio e Estratégia: Entendimento de como o produto se encaixa nos objetivos macro da empresa e no mercado, garantindo que o roadmap esteja alinhado à sustentabilidade financeira e competitividade do negócio. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real. Comportamentais: Liderança inspiradora, comunicação clara e assertiva, disciplina, proatividade, resiliência e visão de dono. Conhecimentos: Gestão de pessoas e processos operacionais, boas práticas de higiene e segurança alimentar (HACCP), sistemas ERP e PDV, padronização de serviços e excelência operacional. Experiência Desejável: Experiência comprovada em gestão de operações de múltiplas unidades, preferencialmente em restaurantes, food service, varejo ou hospitalidade; liderança de equipes grandes e multidisciplinares; histórico de entrega de resultados consistentes e melhoria de performance. title: Pricing & Payments Manager, Partner Strategy & Experience
description: Pricing & Payments Manager, Partner Strategy & Experience Amazon is the most customer-centric company on Earth. We need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people who are passionate about doing the right thing. We are looking for a Pricing & Payments Manager to lead the Pricing, Incentives, Payments & Disputes function within Amazon's Last Mile Brazil organization. This role owns the end-to-end strategy and execution of partner pricing models, incentive programs, payment accuracy, and dispute resolution across our Amazon Partner Logistics programs — EDSP (External Delivery Service Provider), AMPL (Amazon Partner Logistics), and AMXL (Amazon Extra Large). As a People Manager, you will lead and develop a team of specialists, set the strategic direction for pricing and payment mechanisms, build scalable processes, and drive cross‑functional alignment with Finance, Operations, and Procurement to ensure partner economics are competitive, accurate, and sustainable. This position is based out of an Amazon corporate office and may require periodic travel. If you are passionate about partner economics, operational excellence, and building high‑performing teams, you should join our team. Key job responsibilities Lead, coach, and develop a team of Pricing, Incentives, Payments & Disputes specialists, fostering a culture of ownership, analytical rigor, and continuous improvement Own the end‑to‑end pricing strategy for logistics partners across EDSP, AMPL, and AMXL programs, ensuring competitive and sustainable rate structures Design, implement, and optimize incentive programs that drive partner performance, network efficiency, and cost effectiveness Oversee the payment lifecycle — from invoice validation and payment accuracy to dispute identification, root‑cause analysis, and resolution Build and maintain scalable mechanisms for pricing governance, incentive tracking, payment reconciliation, and dispute management Develop structured reporting and dashboards to monitor pricing competitiveness, incentive ROI, payment accuracy, and dispute aging/resolution rates Partner cross‑functionally with Finance, Operations, Procurement, and Legal to align pricing models with business objectives and contractual frameworks Identify and drive automation opportunities to reduce manual intervention in payment and dispute processes Conduct periodic pricing benchmarking and market analysis to ensure Amazon's partner economics remain competitive Manage escalations related to partner payments and disputes, ensuring timely resolution and stakeholder alignment Define and track KPIs for the team, establishing clear goals, performance standards, and development plans for direct reports A day in the life Your day starts with metrics review and the team's priorities. Your focus centers on strategic decisions that shape partner economics across EDSP, AMPL, and AMXL. You lead cross‑functional negotiations with Finance, Operations, and Procurement to align pricing models with business objectives. You assess incentive program ROI, recommending adjustments to optimize cost efficiency and partner performance. You review payment accuracy dashboards, identifying systemic gaps and designing scalable mechanisms to address them. Between meetings, you coach your team on stakeholder influence and data‑driven storytelling. Every day balances strategic thinking, cross‑functional alignment, and talent development to drive sustainable partner economics at scale. About the team The Pricing & Payments team is part of Amazon Logistics' Partner Strategy & Experience organization, supporting the EDSP, AMXL, and AMPL programs across Brazil — a network of +30 logistics partners and +300 operational nodes. Our mission is to ensure Amazon's logistics partners operate under competitive, transparent, and accurate pricing and payment frameworks, while driving performance through well‑designed incentive programs and efficient dispute resolution. We build scalable pricing models, payment governance mechanisms, and incentive strategies that balance cost efficiency with partner sustainability. The team sits within a broader strategic structure that also covers Compliance & Communications, Network Health & Performance, and VAS & DA Experience — working cross‑functionally to support Amazon's Last Mile growth in Brazil. Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent in business, operations, logistics, supply chain or engineering Speak, write, and read fluent in English Experience managing and developing high‑performance teams Experience conducting sophisticated and creative analysis of complex data and translating results into actionable deliverables, messages, and presentations Experience working with cross‑functional teams across business development, marketing, operations, product development, legal, etc. Experience implementing scalable compliance solutions (technology, procedures, processes, etc.) in a regulated environment Experience in communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal in Portuguese & English Experience in deal management and pricing strategy, or financial consulting Preferred Qualifications MBA, or Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field Experience using SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis Experience with Lean or Six Sigma analytical techniques Experience in logistics Knowledge of Six Sigma, Lean manufacturing efforts, transportation and logistics, or fulfillment and distribution centers Experience in financial modeling, P&L management or analysis, or experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field Experience designing incentive programs or performance‑based compensation structures Experience building payment reconciliation or dispute management mechanisms at scale Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Communications Technician
description: Telesat (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT) is a leading global satellite operator, providing reliable and secure satellite-delivered communications solutions worldwide to broadcast, telecommunications, corporate and government customers for over 55 years. Backed by a legacy of engineering excellence, reliability and industry-leading customer service, Telesat has grown to be one of the largest and most successful global satellite operators. Telesat Lightspeed, our revolutionary Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite network, scheduled to begin service in 2027, will revolutionize global broadband connectivity for enterprise and Government users by delivering a combination of high capacity, security, resiliency and affordability with ultra-low latency and fiber-like speeds. Telesat is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, and has offices and facilities around the world. The company’s state-of-the‑art Satellite fleet consists of 14 GEO satellites, the Canadian payload on ViaSat‑1 and one LEO 3 demonstration satellite. For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit Reporting to the Manager, Satellite Operations, the Communications Technician performs real time Telemetry, Track and Control (TTC) of all satellites operated by Telesat Brazil and monitors ground systems according to established procedures and policies; is responsible for all aspects of successful in‑orbit mission operations; serves as an interface to internal and external customers, as it relates to the daily transponder accesses; and is responsible for the overall ground station or facilities operations. Responsibilities Satellite In-Orbit Operations Monitor all in-orbit satellite performance. Provide routine operations to maintain the satellite orbit and subsystems health. Provide emergency system operations in accordance with contingency plans; Respond immediately to all anomalous events and/or alarms; Prepare anomaly reports to engineers for further investigation; Operate, configure and monitor satellite subsystems, including: Power, Thermal, Reaction Control, Attitude, TT&C, and Communications; Perform station keeping maneuvers, battery reconditioning, eclipse operations, and other routine operations; Maintain and operate ground station TT&C equipment: Antenna Control Units, Command, Ranging and Telemetry racks, and Command Encryption modules; Maintain and operate front-end processors and associated computers; Conduct special satellite testing as directed by satellite engineering/management. Customer Service Operations Answer incoming calls from Uplinkers, Customers, and persons requesting information. Perform Uplinker performance checks and transponder-access tests, including Transponder frequency, Polarization, Deviation, and Power. Correlate power/polarization level adjustments with field technicians. Monitor consoles, maintain event logs, and enter information into databases. Perform troubleshooting of reported video and audio troubles using appropriate test equipment. Identify and elevate service outages and abnormal conditions. Assist other technicians during busy times and provide relief during breaks and lunch periods. Respond to all customer trouble calls and inquiries - initiate, review, update, and clear trouble tickets. Coordinate customer booking problems and transponder service extensions with Telesat Engineering. Perform satellite and transponder restorations as directed by the restoration plans. Assist Engineering and customer Field Engineers as requested. Perform in-service 'Console Transponder Calibration' tests using supplied hardware/software. Setup consoles and monitor audio teleconferencing bridges for satellite news feeds. Perform calibration tests on spectrum analyzers and other equipment used in the Service Assurance Center (SAC). Coordinate customer additions and disconnects as directed by scheduled Service Orders. Coordinate satellite transponder change requests as directed by Engineering. Isolate and resolve satellite transponder interferences. Perform certification tests for all new digital uplinkers. Ground Station/Facilities Operations Operate, configure and monitor ground station subsystems, including: Electric, Air Conditioning, Communications, IT; Maintain and operate ground station equipment: Antennas, RF, IF, Communications, test equipment; Record all significant customer activities or internal events in the station log; Maintain and update facility site documentation; Perform preventive and corrective maintenance; Prepare Performance Analysis reports, as requested by engineering/management; Develop, maintain and distribute daily reports, operational shift logs and trouble ticket database to appropriate individuals on a needed basis; Prepare and distribute (E-mail) daily reports; File completed logs; Perform shipping, ordering, handling, inventory, and testing of on‑line and spare parts; Monitor building, fire, and security systems. Handle on-call, special and In-Charge assignments Education and Experience required Technical specialization (Certified Technician) on Telecommunications or Electronics. Ability to write, read and speak on both English and Portuguese languages. Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals; Ability to write routine reports and correspondence; Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization. Decision making and Supervision: Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action; Receives instructions on new assignments or projects; Actively seeks information and guidance to improve own performance. We are committed to providing the best candidate experience possible including any required accommodations at every stage of our interview process. All qualified applicants that have been selected for an interview that require accommodations, are advised to inform the Telesat Talent team accordingly. We will work with you to meet your needs. All accommodation information provided will be treated as confidential. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Faz isso com uma abordagem focada nos principais desafios transformacionais da empresa, nos níveis estratégico e tático e de maneira muito colaborativa com outras áreas de tecnologia e do negócio. A área se estrutura nos papéis de arquitetura corporativa, arquitetura de soluções e arquitetura de dados & IA. Traga sua experiência em benchmarks da indústria, mapas de capacidades, arquiteturas de referência, análises de gaps e buy or build e, construção de visões de futuro e roadmaps de tecnologia. description: Department: Events & Entertainment Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. THE POSITION The Ceremonies Manager supports the end to end planning, creative development, and operational delivery of all official ceremonies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Pre Match Ceremonies (PMC), the Final Match Half Time Show (if applicable), and all additional ceremonial moments. The role supports and coordinates the implementation of the operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, ensuring that all ceremonies are executed in accordance with the Ceremonies Concept developed by FIFA. Working closely with the Entertainment Team and key Functional Areas, the Ceremonies Manager supports the Senior Manager in coordinating the operational delivery of ceremonies, contributing to creative and operational review processes and helping ensure the execution of iconic, culturally resonant moments that celebrate women’s football on its biggest global stage. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Ceremonies Project Leadership Support the operational delivery and implementation of the Ceremonies Concept provided by FIFA. Support the end-to-end planning and delivery of all official ceremonies across the FWWC27 tournament. Oversee ceremonies planning and delivery from concept development through pre-production, execution, dissolution, and legacy handover. Ensure full alignment with the Entertainment team in Zurich across all ceremonial workstreams. Manage the approval process for all ceremony related creative and operational deliverables. Provide senior decision making support on creative direction, technical feasibility, and operational prioritisation. Lead the development of ceremony operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and show formats for all ceremonies, including PMC. Coordinate with Venue Management, Broadcast, Safety & Security, and other Functional Areas to integrate ceremonies seamlessly into match day and event day operations. Escalate ceremony related operational matters. Ensure all ceremonies reflect the approved creative vision, brand standards, cultural sensitivities, and tournament wide entertainment strategy. Team Leadership Support the Ceremonies Team by contributing to day-to-day coordination, operational readiness, and delivery standards. Assist with the onboarding and support of Ceremonies personnel—suppliers, freelancers, and event-time workforce—helping ensure consistent standards and operational preparedness. Contribute to internal talent development through daily guidance, structured feedback, and knowledge sharing. Support effective collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units. Contribute to coordination between venue-based ceremonies teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution. Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Stadium Entertainment Team to ensure unified delivery across all entertainment and ceremonies workstreams. Major Ceremonies Oversight Support the planning and delivery processes for all major ceremonial events, including Opening Ceremony, Closing Ceremony, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Final Match Half-Time Show (if applicable), Pre-Match Ceremonies throughout the tournament. Ensure that each major ceremony reflects the ambition, brand standards, and cultural significance of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™. Creative & Concept Development / Creative Concept, Content Production & Management Support the development and refinement of the ceremonial concept and creative direction for each ceremony in collaboration with the Entertainment Team. Contribute to the integration of host country cultural elements into ceremonial programming in a meaningful, authentic, and respectful manner. Assist in the creation of creative briefs, content commissioning, and pre-production workflows in coordination with internal teams and external agencies. Contribute to stakeholder approval processes to ensure all content is delivered, documented, and archived in line with operational requirements. Support IP and copyright compliance across all ceremony-related content. Planning Scheduling & Documentation Maintain detailed project plans, WIP reports, and milestone trackers for all ceremony workstreams. Ensure operational and creative decisions are fully documented and version controlled. Coordinate with multiple suppliers and conduct regular update meetings, coordinate implementation processes, and supervise payments and reporting. Prepare written and oral presentations, high-level briefings, and reports for senior leadership and FIFA counterparts. Organize and participate in Review, Project Team, and Status Update meetings. Support the creation, management, and archiving of project plans, workflows, venue documentation, and readiness tools across all ceremony workstreams. Contribute to ensuring readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and provide operational support on event days. Support operational decision-making to help maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. Assist with rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals, and stakeholder coordination for all ceremonies. Support venue level preproduction activities, including technical surveys, staging assessments, and infrastructure planning. Supplier & Budget Management Support procurement processes as directed by the Ceremonies Senior Manager, including supplier briefing and evaluation. Manage day-to-day relationships with entertainment suppliers and contractors at assigned venue(s). Assist with budget management tasks, including forecasting inputs, cost tracking, variation documentation, and invoice processing, ensuring accuracy and timely follow-up. Help monitor contractual deliverables and timelines, ensuring they remain aligned with preproduction schedules and operational readiness requirements, and escalute risks to the Senior Manager as needed. Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison Act as a liaison between the Ceremonies Team and all relevant Functional Areas, including Venue Operations, Broadcast, Safety & Security, Marketing, and FIFA SPE, in coordination with the Senior Manager. Deliver concise briefings and alignment updates across all internal and external stakeholders. Support the building and maintenance of relationships with Host Country national bodies, cultural organizations, and local partners contributing to ceremonies. Ensure early phase cross functional integration to support seamless operational delivery. Venue Readiness & Execution Support preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), ceremony production schedules, and PMC rundowns. Direct venue level pre-production processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, performer logistics, and infrastructure planning. Contribute to ensuring readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and support execution on the day of each event. Act as the key operational decision maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. Assist in rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals, and stakeholder coordination. Ensure all creative and technical elements are validated during pre-event testing and rehearsal phases. Other Duties Perform additional responsibilities as required by management aligned with project delivery. Represent the Ceremonies function in cross-functional planning forums and management briefings. Support the Head of Entertainment in strategic planning, operational readiness, and tournament‑wide entertainment integration. YOUR PROFILE Education Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience. Experience 5+ years' experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large-scale public events. Prior experience in a FIFA tournament or comparable major international sports event is highly desirable. Demonstrated experience managing complex, large-scale ceremonies including opening/closing ceremonies and awards presentations. Proven track record in team managership, creative development, supplier management, and cross-functional coordination. Experience managing RFP/procurement processes and overseeing multi-supplier contracts and budgets. Experience integrating cultural programming and working with national cultural bodies and creative agencies. Skills & Competencies ADMINISTRATIVE SKILLS: Ability to manage office and production documentation including RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately. ADAPTABILITY: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high-pressure environments. FLEXIBILITY: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period. COMMUNICATION SKILLS: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level. ORGANIZATIONAL SKILLS: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines. PROBLEM-SOLVING SKILLS: Strategic and creative approach to problem-solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLABORATION: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals. INTERPERSONAL SKILLS: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross-functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment. CULTURAL SENSITIVITY: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant. PASSION FOR ENTERTAINMENT: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire. Certifications & Requirements Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools. Experience of Monday.com an advantage. Knowledge of and previous event / tournament experience across the stadiums in Brazil a plus. The right to work in Brazil. Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Descrição da vaga Nossa área de Tecnologia é um pilar fundamental dos nossos negócios, sendo responsável pela nossa transformação digital. Aqui criamos soluções tecnológicas sempre idealizando e desenvolvendo técnicas e processos de automação, seja para aprimorar a experiência de trabalho das nossas equipes ou aumentar a capacidade de entrega dos nossos produtos e serviços. Nós somos responsáveis por uma infraestrutura gigantesca que atende aos principais produtos de vídeo da Globo, como o Globoplay, Premiere e os Canais Globo. Além disso, somos responsáveis pela transmissão ao vivo de grandes eventos - desde os campeonatos estaduais de futebol, a Copa do Mundo, Olimpíadas, Rock in Rio e até as câmeras ao vivo do Big Brother Brasil, que fica disponível 24x7 para todos os assinantes do Globoplay. Desafios estratégicos O mercado de mídia e entretenimento vive numa constante transformação, com variadas formas, comportamentos, plataformas e monetização do consumo de conteúdo. Múltiplas empresas de diferentes segmentos competem pela atenção e pelo bolso do consumidor e dos anunciantes. Essa constante transformação vem muito da própria evolução da tecnologia no mundo. Nesse cenário, a Globo vem buscando diferentes segmentos de audiência, novos produtos, novas estratégias de distribuição, novas formas de operar e novos modelos de negócio. Para suportar tanta transformação, precisamos entender os movimentos da indústria, o mercado cliente, a nossa estratégia de negócio, as tendências de tecnologia, nossas alavancas e nossos gaps. Projetar novas capacidades de tecnologia, transformar algumas e, buscar inovação e parcerias, se faz absolutamente necessário. Atuação de Arquitetura A Arquitetura de Tecnologia da Globo, busca profissionais que possam trabalhar na interseção entre estratégia de negócio, tecnologia e a execução. A área tem a missão de desenhar e propor estratégias, arquiteturas e roadmaps de evolução tecnológica para diversos domínios de negócio e foundations de tecnologia da empresa. Faz isso com uma abordagem focada nos principais desafios transformacionais da empresa, nos níveis estratégico e tático e de maneira muito colaborativa com outras áreas de tecnologia e do negócio. A área se estrutura nos papéis de arquitetura corporativa, arquitetura de soluções e arquitetura de dados & IA. Traga sua experiência em benchmarks da indústria, mapas de capacidades, arquiteturas de referência, análises de gaps e buy or build e, construção de visões de futuro e roadmaps de tecnologia. O que a área te oferece de oportunidade Vai conduzir trabalhos de grande visibilidade que influenciam decisões estratégicas de tecnologia Você vai ter um conhecimento amplo da empresa e da indústria de mídia Vai desenvolver um olhar transversal e estratégico entre as capacidades de negócio e tecnológicas de toda a empresa Posição de Arquitetura de Dados & IA Esta posição irá ajudar a evoluir a arquitetura fundacional de dados & IA da Globo, que habilita os workloads de analytics, machine learning, generative AI e agentic AI. Diversidade Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação. Ponto de atenção Os resultados imediatos do trabalho desta posição são decisões que vão influenciar a esteira de execução. Portanto, diferentemente de uma área de delivery de software ou operação, as mudanças são sentidas no médio e longo prazo. Aqui, cada pessoa tem voz, espaço e responsabilidade na construção do que fazemos. É assim, todos os dias, que nos tornamos o maior Grupo de Moda da América Latina. Responsabilidades e atribuições Resumo da Posição Buscamos um(a) profissional estratégico e com forte capacidade de execução para liderar nossa jornada de expansão. Você será o maestro da implantação das nossas unidades, garantindo que a qualidade da marca seja preservada e que o franqueado tenha uma experiência de abertura fluida, rentável e dentro dos prazos estabelecidos. Principais Responsabilidades: Gestão de Ciclo de Vida da Implantação: Liderar o processo completo de implantação, desde a aprovação do ponto comercial até a inauguração, atuando como o ponto focal entre franqueados e áreas internas (Arquitetura, Planejamento, Comercial, Trade e Operações). Gestão de KPIs e Riscos: Monitorar o cronograma físico-financeiro (PMO), garantindo o cumprimento de prazos (OTIF) e a aderência ao orçamento (CAPEX). Antecipar riscos e implementar planos de ação para evitar atrasos nas aberturas. Excelência no Padrão de Marca: Elaborar briefings conceituais e realizar inspeções técnicas, assegurando que o padrão arquitetônico e operacional seja rigorosamente seguido. Gestão de Fornecedores: Supervisionar a performance de empreiteiras, fornecedores de mobiliário e equipamentos, garantindo qualidade, custo e entrega. Suporte e Relacionamento: Ser a interface consultiva do franqueado, oferecendo suporte contínuo durante a obra e orientando na manutenção preventiva de lojas existentes para preservação do ativo. Melhoria Contínua: Analisar indicadores de performance das inaugurações para propor melhorias nos processos internos, reduzindo o Time-to-Market e otimizando custos de implantação. Requisitos e qualificações Experiência: Sólida experiência em gestão de obras de varejo ou expansão de franquias. Formação: Superior completo em Arquitetura, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas. Domínio de Ferramentas: Proficiência em MS Project ou ferramentas de gestão de cronograma, Excel (nível intermediário/avançado) e leitura de projetos. Diferencial: Experiência com negociação de contratos e gestão de stakeholders complexos. Visão de Dono: Foco total em eficiência, custo e qualidade. Capacidade de Influência: Habilidade para transitar entre diferentes áreas da companhia (Comercial, Financeiro, Operações) e conduzir o franqueado durante o processo. Resiliência e Agilidade: Capacidade de gerir múltiplas frentes simultâneas em um ambiente dinâmico. Orientação para Resultados: Foco em metas, prazos e indicadores de sucesso. Informações adicionais NOSSOS BENEFÍCIOS No Azzas 2154 Fashion & Lifestyle, acreditamos que cuidar das pessoas é parte essencial para construir o maior Grupo de Moda da América Latina. Por isso, oferecemos um conjunto de benefícios pensado para apoiar o bem-estar, o desenvolvimento e o dia a dia de quem faz parte da nossa história. Saúde e bem estar Plano de saúde Plano odontológico Seguro de vida Programas de bem-estar físico, como Wellhub ou TotalPass Iniciativas de apoio à saúde mental Dia a dia e qualidade de vida Benefícios flexíveis por meio de cartão Flash Vale transporte Parceria com o SESC Clube de vantagens com parceiros Day off de aniversário Extensão de licença maternidade Extensão de licença paternidade Descontos nas marcas do grupo Desenvolvimento e crescimento Programas de capacitação e desenvolvimento Trilhas de aprendizagem corporativas Iniciativas de reconhecimento e engajamento Reconhecimento Participação nos resultados, conforme política vigente * Os benefícios podem variar de acordo com o cargo, a unidade e as políticas internas da companhia. Sonhar grande para fazer gigante, com gente boa e do bem. #J-18808-Ljbffr

E se o mundo está tão diferente por que as academias são todas iguais? Chegamos para fazer diferente. Propósito Existimos para ser uma ferramenta poderosa de transformação através de atividades física e esportes. Nascemos como um agente incansável de mudanças, incentivando, motivando e oferecendo a estrutura e serviços adequados para a prática de exercícios. Responsabilidades e Atribuições do cargo Supervisionar e coordenar a equipe e atividades da unidade. Elaborar relatórios e atualizar relatórios com os indicadores e performance da unidade. Monitorar os indicadores de desempenho da unidade e avaliar a equipe de forma coletiva e individual. Participar, acompanhar e solucionar (quando possível) os itens avaliados em auditorias internas. Realizar reuniões periódicas com a equipe (consultor de vendas, consultor fitness, coach de ginástica, limpeza e manutenção). Acompanhar obras de reparo e equipes de manutenção, tanto como predial, equipamento e limpeza. Fazer pesquisa na região com os concorrentes. Tratar e responder todas as manifestações vindas NPS, SAC, Site e Redes Sociais ou pessoalmente dos alunos, ouvindo, avaliando e decidindo com imparcialidade. Tratar e solucionar os conflitos com os alunos. Supervisionar o atendimento de toda a equipe. Controlar o estoque e suprimentos para unidade. Coordenar toda a manutenção predial e de equipamentos, solicitar orçamentos e pesquisar melhores preços. Entrevistar e selecionar pessoas para fazer parte da equipe (quando necessário). Participar do processo de admissão de novos membros, receber e conferir os documentos admissionais dos membros aprovados e enviar para contabilidade. Gerenciar o ponto eletrônico da unidade. Auxiliar no processo administrativo da unidade, como admissão, demissão, férias, faltas, marcação de ponto, escala de trabalho, fechamento da folha, etc. Zelar pela perfeita conservação, limpeza, proporcionando ordem no local de trabalho. Executar outras tarefas correlatadas, conforme necessidade do serviço e orientação do superior imediato. title: Sales Development Associate
description: Job Description This role is the commercial growth track for NDT Global’s/ TSC Subsea ILI and Subsea & Robotics business in South America. Reporting directly to the Country Manager and working alongside experienced Regional Sales Managers, the Sales Development Associate is responsible for identifying and developing new opportunities, managing the sales pipeline, and progressively building direct client relationships. The role carries regional revenue contribution targets and is based in the Rio de Janeiro office. It is designed as a structured pathway toward full sales ownership. Role and Responsibilities Manage and develop a qualified opportunity pipeline, maintaining accurate and up-to-date records in the CRM (Salesforce or equivalent). Identify and qualify new business opportunities across the ILI and subsea inspection market in South America. Lead and coordinate the preparation of technical-commercial proposals and bid responses, ensuring alignment with client requirements and NDT Global standards. Build and maintain direct relationships with existing and prospective clients, progressively taking ownership of key accounts. Work alongside Regional Sales Managers to support deal progression, client engagement strategies, and market development initiatives. Monitor market trends, track competitor activity, and contribute market intelligence to refine regional sales strategies. Represent NDT Global at industry events, conferences, and client meetings, participating actively in commercial and technical discussions. Develop a solid working knowledge of ILI, subsea, and robotics inspection technologies, applications, and value propositions. Support the Country Manager with forecasting, pipeline reporting, and commercial planning activities. Contribute to broader commercial initiatives as the role evolves and sales ownership expands. Qualifications and Requirements Education: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, production engineering, business administration, or related fields. A postgraduate degree in business management or asset integrity is a plus. Equivalent commercial experience of 3+ years will also be considered. Commercial experience: Previous exposure to proposal development, bid management, or B2B sales processes is strongly desirable. CRM proficiency: Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, or equivalent CRM platforms is an advantage. Software: Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Languages: Fluent Portuguese (native level), advanced English required. Spanish is a strong plus for broader regional coverage. Industry knowledge: Familiarity with oil & gas, pipeline integrity, or subsea inspection markets is highly desirable but not mandatory. Skillset Commercially driven, with genuine motivation to develop and close business. Strong communicator — able to engage confidently with clients and adapt messaging to technical and non-technical audiences. Resilient and persistent, comfortable operating in long sales cycles and complex procurement environments. Strategic thinker, capable of mapping the market and identifying where value can be created. Self-starter with a high level of personal accountability and ownership. Collaborative, able to work effectively within a structured sales team while also operating independently. Curious and quick to learn, with an interest in inspection technology and the energy sector. Opportunity to work on cutting-edge NDT technologies that ensure the safety and reliability of critical offshore infrastructure. Collaborative and innovative work environment with a focus on professional development and growth. Competitive salary and benefits package. Further career development through additional company provided training. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Arquiteta de Soluções Pleno em Infra e Telecom | Arquitetura de Tecnologia - Vaga exclusiva par[...]
description: Descrição da vaga Nossa área de Tecnologia é um pilar fundamental dos nossos negócios, sendo responsável pela nossa transformação digital. Aqui criamos soluções tecnológicas sempre idealizando e desenvolvendo técnicas e processos de automação, seja para aprimorar a experiência de trabalho das nossas equipes ou aumentar a capacidade de entrega dos nossos produtos e serviços. Nós somos responsáveis por uma infraestrutura gigantesca que atende aos principais produtos de vídeo da Globo, como o Globoplay, Premiere e os Canais Globo. Além disso, somos responsáveis pela transmissão ao vivo de grandes eventos - desde os campeonatos estaduais de futebol, a Copa do Mundo, Olimpíadas, Rock in Rio e até as câmeras ao vivo do Big Brother Brasil, que fica disponível 24x7 para todos os assinantes do Globoplay. Desafios estratégicos O mercado de mídia e entretenimento vive numa constante transformação, com variadas formas, comportamentos, plataformas e monetização do consumo de conteúdo. Múltiplas empresas de diferentes segmentos competem pela atenção e pelo bolso do consumidor e dos anunciantes. Essa constante transformação vem muito da própria evolução da tecnologia no mundo. Nesse cenário, a Globo vem buscando diferentes segmentos de audiência, novos produtos, novas estratégias de distribuição, novas formas de operar e novos modelos de negócio. Para suportar tanta transformação, precisamos entender os movimentos da indústria, o mercado cliente, a nossa estratégia de negócio, as tendências de tecnologia, nossas alavancas e nossos gaps. Projetar novas capacidades de tecnologia, transformar algumas e, buscar inovação e parcerias, se faz absolutamente necessário. Atuação de Arquitetura A Arquitetura de Tecnologia da Globo busca profissionais que possam trabalhar na interseção entre estratégia de negócio, tecnologia e a execução. A área tem a missão de desenhar e propor estratégias, arquiteturas e roadmaps de evolução tecnológica para diversos domínios de negócio e foundations de tecnologia da empresa. Faz isso com uma abordagem focada nos principais desafios transformacionais da empresa, nos níveis estratégico e tático e de maneira muito colaborativa com outras áreas de tecnologia e do negócio. A área se estrutura nos papéis de arquitetura corporativa, arquitetura de soluções e arquitetura de dados & IA. Traga sua experiência em benchmarks da indústria, mapas de capacidades, arquiteturas de referência, análises de gaps e buy or build e na construção de visões de futuro e roadmaps de tecnologia. O que a área te oferece de oportunidade Vai conduzir trabalhos de grande visibilidade que influenciam decisões estratégicas de tecnologia Você vai ter um conhecimento amplo da empresa e da indústria de mídia Vai desenvolver um olhar transversal e estratégico entre as capacidades de negócio e tecnológicas de toda a empresa Modelo de trabalho Híbrido (RJ ou SP) Responsabilidades e atribuições Como será seu dia a dia Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de Infraestrutura e Telecom, garantindo alinhamento com a estratégia tecnológica e de negócio da companhia; Construir e manter modelos arquiteturais, mapas de capacidades, princípios, padrões e roadmaps tecnológicos para orientar decisões executivas e estruturantes de I&T; Produzir desenhos arquiteturais de alto nível conectando domínios, plataformas e capacidades tecnológicas; Atuar de forma crítica e consultiva junto às áreas técnicas, questionando soluções, identificando lacunas e propondo direcionamentos estruturantes; Avaliar impactos arquiteturais de novas iniciativas, tecnologias e decisões estratégicas; Incorporar o conceito de AI-First Architecture nas decisões e modelos arquiteturais, promovendo automação, inteligência operacional e uso estratégico de dados; Comunicar e apresentar conceitos arquiteturais para públicos técnicos e executivos. Requisitos e qualificações Do que você precisa Formação superior em carreiras de tecnologia, como engenharias, ciência da computação, etc; Inglês intermediário para leitura, escrita e comunicação; Experiência como arquiteto corporativo, arquiteto de domínio ou arquiteto de soluções; Experiência em ambientes tecnológicos complexos, distribuídos, híbridos ou multicloud; Conhecimento prático em Infraestrutura, Telecomunicações ou ambos, com capacidade de sustentar decisões arquiteturais nesses domínios; Experiência na definição de arquiteturas e direcionamentos técnicos em contextos de transformação tecnológica ou organizacional; Experiência em modelagem de capacidades (Capability Mapping) e construção de modelos arquiteturais; Capacidade de definir princípios, padrões e roadmaps tecnológicos; Conhecimento em infraestrutura on-premises, cloud ou ambientes híbridos; Entendimento de resiliência, disponibilidade, escalabilidade, automação e observabilidade em plataformas tecnológicas; Conhecimento em arquitetura de redes, conectividade e serviços de telecom; Entendimento conceitual de IA e suas relações com infraestrutura e telecom. Conhecimentos que te destacam Experiência em ambientes multicloud ou arquiteturas híbridas complexas; Experiência com infraestrutura como código e automação de plataformas; Vivência em telecom definidos por software (SDN / NFV); Experiência em integração entre ambientes on-premises e cloud; Conhecimento em uso de IA em operações de tecnologia (AIOps ou Enterprise AI Solutions Architecture); Experiência anterior em arquitetura de soluções, engenharia ou operações, combinada com visão sistêmica; Pós-graduação ou especialização em Arquitetura, Tecnologia, Telecom, Cloud ou áreas afins. Informações adicionais sobre a Globo Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos. Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação. A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles. Aqui, cada um faz a transformação acontecer. Os seus dados pessoais serão utilizados para fins de seleção de candidatos para preenchimento das vagas abertas na Globo. Os dados pessoais coletados durante o processo seletivo dos candidatos que não forem admitidos neste momento poderão ser mantidos nos bancos de dados para consideração em futuros processos seletivos. Todos os dados coletados serão tratados segundo rigorosos padrões de segurança da informação e em total respeito às leis de privacidade aplicáveis, incluindo a Lei 13.709/18, e nos termos de nossa política de privacidade. Ao prosseguir você está ciente e de acordo para realização de sua candidatura nestes termos. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Production Control Engineer
description: The Production Control Engineer will be responsible for ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and traceability of production data, acting as the technical authority for hydrocarbon accounting, allocation, reconciliation, and reporting across offshore facilities. Working closely with metering, subsurface, finance, and commercial teams, the role will guarantee reliable calculation and reporting of oil, gas, water, and associated fluids, while driving continuous improvement of accounting systems, data quality, and best practice. Responsibilities Ensure accurate hydrocarbon accounting for oil, gas, water, and associated fluids, including production allocation, reconciliation, inventory management, ullage calculations, and custody transfer, as well as injection, waste, and emissions, performed within internal and industry standards with due diligence, analysis, and data validation. Work closely with Metering, Subsurface, and Facilities teams to review production data and uncertainties, address measurement and reconciliation discrepancies, and coordinate corrective actions. Perform, validate, and approve daily, monthly, and annual production reconciliations between metering systems, tank inventories, export measurements, and allocation calculations prior to regulatory and internal reporting. Support the classification and allocation of production deferment or losses according to internal guidelines. title: Country Lead, Brazil
description: Overview Samba is a media intelligence company. We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about in real time, at scale, across every screen. Our data exists with the consent of over a billion people, organized into the most complete picture of consumer attention ever built. The biggest brands in the world use that picture to make smarter decisions. We think it’s the most interesting data asset on the planet, because it’s the most culturally relevant. Samba is entering the Brazilian market, and we are looking for an entrepreneurial, multi-disciplinary consultant to lead the charge on the ground. This is a true 0-to-1 opportunity: you won’t inherit a playbook — you’ll write it. You’ll combine commercial acumen, business development instincts, and technical fluency to establish Samba\'s presence, build partnerships, drive initial revenue, and shape go-to-market products tailored to local market conditions and regulatory requirements. This role sits at the intersection of commercial partnerships, business development, solutions engineering, and market strategy. We need someone who can pitch to senior brand and agency contacts in the morning, troubleshoot data integrations in the afternoon, and brief our product team on local market requirements in the evening. If you thrive in ambiguity, build structure where none exists, and are energized by the prospect of building a new market from scratch — this role is for you. This is a contract / consultant engagement based in São Paulo. The initial engagement period will be defined based on mutual alignment, with the potential for extension or conversion based on market traction and business needs. Travel within Brazil is expected; occasional travel to Samba offices in the US or other international locations may be required. What You'll Do Own the commercial strategy for Brazil: identify target accounts, build pipeline, and close initial deals across agencies, advertisers, and media companies. Take a consultative approach to sales — educate the market on Samba\'s data, measurement, and audience solutions while adapting value propositions to local needs. Develop and execute account plans for key prospects, manage the full sales cycle from prospecting through close, and maintain accurate forecasting. Identify, evaluate, and negotiate strategic partnerships with local broadcasters, OEMs, data providers, platforms, and technology partners critical to Samba\'s Brazil infrastructure. Map the Brazilian media, advertising, and data ecosystem — understand who the key players are, where the opportunities lie, and what partnerships unlock scale. Serve as the technical point of contact for prospects and partners — scope integrations, troubleshoot implementation questions, and translate Samba\'s product capabilities into client-specific solutions. Provide technical pre-sales support: run product demos, respond to RFIs/RFPs, and build proof-of-concept solutions that demonstrate value. Develop a comprehensive Brazil market entry strategy encompassing regulatory landscape, competitive positioning, data privacy compliance (LGPD), partnership requirements, and revenue projections. Build the operational foundation for Samba\'s Brazil presence — define processes, reporting cadences, and success metrics. Provide regular market updates and strategic recommendations to Samba\'s international and executive leadership. Who You Are Entrepreneurial builder with 10+ years of commercial experience in ad tech, media, data, or DaaS/SaaS — with a proven track record of launching products, entering new markets, and closing deals in Brazil or broader Latin America. Commercially sharp and strategically minded: you\'ve built pipelines, closed deals, and thought beyond quota to build something new, whether through a consulting, market entry, or strategic commercial background. Technically fluent: you understand APIs, data integrations, programmatic ecosystems, and measurement methodologies well enough to hold your own in technical conversations and troubleshoot client implementations. Deeply networked across the Brazilian ecosystem: established relationships with agencies, broadcasters, platforms, and advertisers, including major holding companies such as Publicis, WPP, Omnicom, Dentsu, Havas, and IPG. Knowledgeable about the Brazilian media and data landscape: including the television ecosystem (Globo, SBT, Record, RedeTV!, pay TV, OTT/streaming, ACR/smart TV), audience data, cross-screen measurement, and data privacy regulations (LGPD). Trilingual: native or professional fluency in Portuguese, English, and Spanish is required. Self-directed and cross-functional: you operate with significant autonomy, set your own priorities, and collaborate effectively across sales, product, engineering, legal, and marketing, often across time zones. Comfortable at the executive level: confident presenting to C-suite buyers and navigating complex, enterprise-level negotiations. MBA or equivalent advanced degree from a top-tier program is preferred. Samba is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We strive to empower connection with one another, reflect the communities we serve, and tackle meaningful projects that make a real impact. For further details, please see Samba\'s Applicant Privacy Policy. For residents of the EU, Samba Inc. is the data controller. title: Senior Manager, Ocean Policy
description: Overview Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together. Position summary – This position is open for consideration in the following locations in the Americas, with preference for candidates based in time zones that can accommodate calls with colleagues in Europe and Africa: Arlington-US, Brazil(remote), Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Guyana, Mexico, Suriname, Peru. Over the last 10 years, CI has developed a comprehensive Blue Climate program spanning over 20 countries dedicated to identifying and addressing science and policy priorities for oceans and climate globally. The Blue Climate program within the Center for Oceans at CI works closely with our field programs across the Americas, Asia-Pacific and Africa to design and implement innovative approaches to (1) implement nature-based climate adaptation solutions that improve coastal and marine communities’ livelihoods and resilience while also conserving ecosystems and biodiversity; and (2) conserve and restore coastal blue carbon ecosystems (mangroves, salt marshes, and seagrass meadows) for climate change mitigation. The Blue Climate program also has key leadership roles in advancing climate mitigation and adaptation priorities into national and regional coastal management and science through the International Blue Carbon Institute, Blue Carbon Initiative, the International Partnership for Blue Carbon, the Global Mangrove Alliance and the Global Green-Gray Community of Practice, and policy with the Center for Policy and Incentives. Responsibilities International Ocean Policy Manage strategic policy initiatives to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, green-gray infrastructure, blue carbon, and other ocean-climate areas which integrate and align international and national policy goals. Work closely with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure ocean-climate strategies and approaches are aligned with international and national policy programs and priorities. Play a key role in project development, fundraising, implementation, communications, and broader capacity building for the Ocean Policy program. Contribute to the drafting and revision of CI ocean policy positions, policy briefs, guidance documents, and other technical resources. Play a key role in representing the Center for Oceans within the CI delegation to international policy meetings related to climate, biodiversity, and oceans, such as the UNFCCC climate COP and intersessional meetings. Additionally, support CI’s strategic engagement in these spaces (e.g., side events, meetings with countries and partners). Support the development and management of relationships and partnerships with government representatives and like-minded organizations to accelerate and achieve CI ocean policy objectives in close coordination with CI’s international policy team and relevant country programs. Ocean Policy Advancement in Priority Countries In partnership with CI country programs, the International Blue Carbon Institute, and the Center for Policy and Incentives, support the development and implementation of national or regional ocean policy objectives and programs which are aligned with and inform CI’s Blue Climate and broader policy priorities. Provide CI programs and partners with strategic support, technical expertise, and/or capacity building for the integration of coastal ecosystems into Nationally Determined Contributions and implementation plans, national climate and ocean policy, greenhouse gas inventories, NBSAPs and other related components of ocean-climate policy. As needed, facilitate in-person and virtual meetings, workshops, and related events with national governments and local partners to advance the priorities of CI country programs in alignment with national objectives. Support the Ocean Policy Director in scoping new policy activities in accordance with existing CI programs. Blue Climate Program Contribute to strategy development, planning processes, fundraising, team initiatives/special projects, reporting and communication efforts as needed. Coordinate with other teams across the Blue Climate network team to ensure programmatic alignment and synergies between CI projects. Other duties as assigned by supervisor. Working Conditions Frequent international travel (25% or more) is required. Ability to work in remote locations or under difficult working conditions. This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some days remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process. Requires working remotely with colleagues in other locations and time zones. Flexible working hours: Frequent early morning and evening meetings, and occasional work over weekends, to accommodate colleagues in other time zones or high-level policy events. Qualifications Required Bachelor’s degree 5 to 7 years of experience working in international climate and/or ocean policy mechanisms and fora. Understanding of government processes and the overall policy engagement environment. Strong organization, project management, and prioritization skills. Excellent time management skills and ability to adapt in a fast-paced, changing environment. Ability to work both independently and as part of a diverse, international team. Experience partnering with, and influencing, key stakeholders and building strong partnerships across public and private sectors and civil society. Excellent written and oral communication skills, and ability to effectively communicate complex information to a diverse audience. Enthusiasm and capacity for learning scientific and related basis for specific conservation outcomes as needed to support policy priorities and processes. Fluency in written and spoken English. Preferred Bi-lingual or multilingual in official UN languages. Expertise in coastal blue carbon and marine ecosystems, climate change science, and/or nature-based solutions Master's degree or other advanced degree in environmental policy or related field. Experience working globally in a range of cultural settings. To apply for this position, please submit a resume and cover letter. We believe in hiring based on merit and qualifications, ensuring a fair and inclusive hiring process for everyone. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Mechanical and Rotating Equipment Engineer (Onshore)
description: Job Overview Airswift is seeking a Mechanical and Rotating Equipment Engineer (Onshore) to in Rio de Janeiro, in a permanent position with an Oil and Gas Company. Job Responsibilities Act as a Technical Authority (Integrity) to evaluate and respond to Management of Change (MOC) and Technical Assistance (TA) requests. Lead Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA/RCA) and develop reliability and maintenance strategies for rotating equipment (pumps, compressors, turbines, gearboxes, and dry gas seal systems), ensuring compliance with company standards and international codes, increasing MTBF and reducing downtime. Evaluate, respond to, and approve MOC/TA requests, technical changes, and deviations, ensuring compliance with company standards and applicable regulations (API/ASME/ISO/ABNT). Issue Technical Notes and Guidelines as a recognized subject matter expert, standardizing practices and lessons learned. Ensure complete documentation, traceability, and clear communication with onshore/offshore stakeholders. Performance Monitoring and Improvement (Condition Monitoring) Monitor the performance of rotating equipment using PDM/CBM techniques: vibration analysis, thermography, and oil analysis (including ferrography and spectroscopy) for early anomaly detection. Supervise and execute Product/Performance Data Monitoring (PDM) services, recommending corrective and preventive actions. Develop and implement condition-based maintenance (CBM) programs to optimize availability and reduce downtime. Develop and implement reliability and maintenance (RCM) strategies, with preventive/predictive plans to improve MTBF and lifecycle cost. Perform diagnostics on pumps, centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, gearboxes, and dry gas seal systems; recommend corrective actions. Identify and manage problematic components, conduct disposal plans, and prioritize investments to sustain reliability improvements. Lead the ACR for recurring failures and problems using structured methodologies (5 Whys, Ishikawa, TapRooT, etc.); issue actionable reports and verify the effectiveness of actions. Conduct component failure analyses (seals, bearings, rotors, gears, shafts) and propose design, operational, or maintenance improvements. Provide daily technical support to Operations and Maintenance areas to resolve machine problems, unplanned downtime, and optimize control/operating parameters. Offer guidance for commissioning/start-up, operations, reviews, and updates of controls/monitoring for rotating equipment. Support capital projects by reviewing maintainability and reliability specifications and ensuring correct installation/alignment according to API/AGMA/ISO standards. Support the preparation of Technical Risk Assessments (ART) and contribute to the continuous improvement of processes and systems. Job Qualifications Education: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering. MBA/Postgraduate degree in Reliability, Maintenance, or Asset Management is a plus. Advanced English required. Experience in operation, maintenance, or reliability of rotating equipment in the Oil and Gas sector (offshore/onshore), focusing on centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, pumps, and turbomachinery. Solid knowledge of rotating equipment reliability, RCM, CBM, and PDM services. Hands‑on experience in condition monitoring (vibration, oil analysis, thermography) and fault diagnosis. Proven experience in troubleshooting and field condition monitoring. Solid knowledge of API standards (e.g., 610/617/618/670/682/686), machine design, lubrication, mechanical seals (including dry gas seals), rotor dynamics, balancing, alignment, and modal analysis. Practical knowledge of international codes and standards (ASME, ANSI, ISO 10816/20816). In‑depth knowledge of rotating equipment: pumps, compressors, dry gas seal systems and gearboxes. Certification in vibration analysis (e.g., ISO CAT II/III) desirable; certifications in oil analysis/thermography are an advantage. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Consultor de Negócios (Ekotruck)

title: Coordenador de Obras
description: # Coordenador de ObrasRio de Janeiro - RJPresential1 PositionEffective - CLTSupervisorFull time**Principais atividades*** Acompanhamento de obras e reformas;* Pedido de compras e acompanhamento;* Elaboração e acompanhamento de cronograma;* Soluções em obra;* Líder da equipe de mão de obra própria, distribuindo os colaboradores nas necessidades das obras em andamento;* Contratação de construtoras para execução das obras e reformas, elaboração de planilhas e concorrências**Requisitos*** Ensino superior completo em engenharia civil ou arquitetura;* Pacote Office, Excel avançado, AutoCAD;* Experiencia em execução de obras, seja construção nova ou reforma, com foco em varejo;* Experiencia em equalização de planilhas para aquisição de produtos e contratação de obras;* Conhecimentos de técnicas construtivas.* Proatividade, Liderança, Senso de dono**Benefícios*** Vale Transporte* Vale Refeição* Convênio SESC* Convênio com Instituições de Ensino* Cesta básica* Assistência Médica* Assistência Odontológica* Total Pass**Jornada de Trabalho*** Presencial* 44 horas semanais**Etapas do Processo*** Cadastro* Entrevista com o Recrutador* Entrevista com o Gerente* Proposta e ASO* Contratação---### Requirements##### StudiesUniversity education---### Valued##### Professional experienceBetween 3 and 5 years---### BenefitsConvênio com Instituições de EnsinoTotal PassAssistência médicaConvênio SESCCesta básicaVale RefeiçãoVale TransporteAssistência odontológica---### About VenancioBEM-VINDOS À MAIS AMADA DO RIO! QUEM SOMOS Somos a Venancio, uma marca carioca que há mais de 46 anos coloca o cuidado no centro de tudo o que faz. Com mais de 140 lojas físicas e mais de 5.000 colaboradores, estamos presentes em diversos bairros do Rio de Janeiro e municípios como Niterói, São Gonçalo, Duque de Caxias, Angra dos Reis, Nova Iguaçu, São João de Meriti, Petrópolis, Teresópolis, Búzios, Volta Redonda, Cabo Frio e São Pedro da Aldeia. Por meio dos nossos canais digitais, ampliamos a atuação para mais de 10 estados, levando saúde, beleza e bem-estar a milhares de clientes em todo o Brasil. Temos orgulho de ter sido eleitos pela Veja Rio como a Farmácia Mais Amada do Rio de Janeiro – um reconhecimento que celebra a confiança e o carinho de todos que fazem parte da nossa história. NOSSO PROPÓSITO Cuidar das pessoas de forma acessível, humanizada e inovadora. Acreditamos que saúde vai além de medicamentos: é sobre qualidade de vida, prevenção e bem-estar. Em 2014, expandimos nossa atuação com a Hospinova, empresa do Grupo Venancio especializada no mercado hospitalar e distribuição farmacêutica. E para sustentar nosso crescimento, contamos com três Centros de Distribuição estrategicamente localizados no Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo e Belo Horizonte. O QUE NOS TORNA ÚNICOS - Nossa essência carioca - O acolhimento genuíno no atendimento - A busca constante por inovação Valorizamos o capital humano, investimos na capacitação de nossos times e atuamos com ética, transparência e simplicidade. Aqui, cada cliente é prioridade e cada detalhe importa. E a Venancio não para: até o final de 2025, inauguraremos mais 23 lojas e continuaremos crescendo, sempre com o compromisso de oferecer atendimento de excelência e soluções completas para o bem-estar. CRESÇA COM A GENTE! Para levar as melhores sensações aos nossos clientes, precisamos de pessoas que trabalhem realizadas e comprometidas em alcançar a excelência no nosso atendimento. Se você compartilha da nossa paixão por cuidar de pessoas, venha fazer parte desse time que transforma vidas todos os dias. #VemSerVenancio #J-18808-Ljbffr

Works closely with Product, Technology, Research, and Business stakeholders to translate user needs and business goals into scalable, data‑driven experience solutions. Acts as a UX point of reference for journey‑level decisions, balancing user needs, business objectives, and technical constraints. Translates qualitative and quantitative insights into clear experience opportunities. Understands and anticipates how design decisions impact customer satisfaction, engagement, and retention. Monitors market trends, competitive movements, and industry best practices to inform journey improvements.
